source_name: НБРСМ — Одлука за листа на најрепрезентативни услуги поврзани со платежната сметка и форма на информативниот документ за надоместоците
why_relevant: Defines the standardised fee vocabulary and template (FID/SoF equivalents) every MK provider must use — the schema key that makes cross-bank tariff comparison machine-comparable, including ATM cash withdrawal as a representative service.

source_name: NBRSM press release — Western Balkans payment systems modernisation and regional interlinking (Banca d'Italia / ECB supported)
why_relevant: Found only via Macedonian-language search. Documents MK's participation in the ECB/Banca d'Italia-backed regional payment-system interlinking initiative — the MK-side entry point to a regional programme whose analytical outputs are the comparator material this cell needs. Also names the institutional counterparts to track.

source_name: НБРСМ — unofficial consolidated text of the PSPS Law (PDF, 144-25)
why_relevant: Full current statutory text including register provisions, interchange/'заменски надоместок' definitions and fee-transparency rules; the filename suffix (144-25) signals the latest amending Gazette issue, making version tracking easy.

source_name: Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи (неофицијален пречистен текст, НБРСМ)
why_relevant: Defines 'заменски надоместок' (interchange fee) and 'надоместок од примачот на плаќањето' (merchant service charge) and the disclosure duties behind every tariff book — the legal frame that determines what must be public and how often it changes.

source_name: Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи — consolidated text (NBRSM PDF)
why_relevant: Primary law defining PI/EMI categories, agent and distributor rules, safeguarding of client funds, and the reporting obligations that generate all downstream non-bank payment statistics. Anchor document for interpreting every other source in the cell.

source_name: НБРСМ mirror of the AML/CFT Law (Закон за спречување перење пари и финансирање тероризам, консолидиран текст)
why_relevant: Consolidated AML law text as maintained for supervised financial institutions; contains the cash-transaction thresholds and reporting duties that bear directly on cash usage measurement.

source_name: NBRSM — Report on payment cards (historical PDF series, WBStorage)
why_relevant: Concrete example of the central bank's card-report PDF series stored under the /WBStorage/Files/ path with a 'Platni sistemi_' prefix — evidence of a predictable file-naming pattern that can be enumerated for the historical card/ATM/POS report back-catalogue.

source_name: Invest North Macedonia — Public procurement guide (English framework overview)
why_relevant: Official English-language explanation of thresholds, procedure types and where notices are published. Useful for calibrating what falls inside/outside ЕСЈН (the MKD 500,000 threshold matters a lot for small POS purchases) and for onboarding non-Macedonian-reading analysts.

source_name: Министерство за финансии — portal.mdt.gov.mk consolidated financial-system laws compendium
why_relevant: Government-published compendium of the laws governing the financial system, containing the editorially consolidated PSPS Law text. Useful as a non-bot-defended mirror when nbrm.mk blocks, and as evidence of Ministry-of-Finance policy ownership.

source_name: Програма на економски реформи 2025-2027 (Economic Reform Programme, Ministry of Finance)
why_relevant: Government's forward-looking reform commitments to the EU, which typically carry dated milestones for payments reform (instant payments, SEPA, digitalisation of payments, cash-economy measures). Gives intended timelines that can be tested against actual regulatory events.

source_name: Министерство за европски прашања — SEPA accession announcements
why_relevant: Official government record of North Macedonia's SEPA accession (accepted by the European Payments Council as the 39th SEPA member; PSP operational readiness Oct 2025, effective 7 Oct 2025). SEPA access reshapes euro clearing routing and is the key structural change in this cell's infrastructure layer.

source_name: Министерство за финансии — Стратегија за формализирање на неформалната економија 2023–2027
why_relevant: The national policy document on the informal economy; sets the government's own shadow-economy framing, measures and targets, which in this country are tightly bound to cash use, fiscalisation and card acceptance.

source_name: УЈП — Фискализација и регистрирање на готовинските плаќања (handbook)
why_relevant: Authoritative reference on who must fiscalise, device requirements and cash-payment registration rules — the legal/technical baseline for interpreting MK cash-usage and POS-terminal dynamics and for vendor market sizing.

source_name: DDK Law (Skopje) — English translation/overview of the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems
why_relevant: Local-firm English rendering of the law's structure and licence categories; useful bridge between the Macedonian statutory text and English analysis, and a check on terminology mapping (e.g. заменски надоместок = interchange fee).

source_name: Sitel — JSP tariff / Skopska card and mobile payment coverage
why_relevant: National broadcaster reporting on JSP fare/payment-channel changes; useful as an event feed for transit payment milestones when the operator itself publishes little.

source_name: Пари.мк / Вечер — известувања за членарини за картички и промени на тарифи
why_relevant: Mainstream business media occasionally publishes cross-bank card annual-fee tables (e.g. Sparkasse 1,500 MKD; CKB and TTK 1,200 MKD) and aggregate fee-income figures, which help benchmark tariff data against revenue reality.

source_name: Стопанска банка АД Скопје — Општи правила и услови за прифаќање на платежни трансакции засновани на картички (merchant acquiring terms)
why_relevant: Rare public merchant-acquiring contract terms: card acceptance rules, chargeback handling, settlement timing and the basis on which the merchant service charge is levied. Highest-value document type in this cell because acquiring pricing is normally opaque.

source_name: Bank general terms & conditions / fee tariffs as regulatory-compliance artefacts (Stopanska banka, Komercijalna banka, ProCredit, Alta, CCBank)
why_relevant: The PSPS Law forces standardised, dated publication of framework contracts, fee terms and payment-account information documents. Versioned PDFs (e.g. valid from 01.01.2026, 01.03.2026) reveal in near-real time how banks re-price cards, ATM/POS and instant transfers in response to regulation — an indirect but high-frequency read on interchange and fee policy.

source_name: MIA / Нова Македонија / МКД.МК — instant payments and TIPS-clone coverage
why_relevant: Macedonian media relay NBRSM statements on joining the ECB/TIPS-based instant-payments initiative (with reported timing alongside Albania and Kosovo, following Bosnia and Montenegro). Fastest dated signal for go-live milestones, to be confirmed against NBRSM primary sources.

source_name: Nova Makedonija / Telma / Pari.com.mk — mainstream coverage of cash limits, cash preference and UJP fiscalisation controls
why_relevant: General media carry datapoints that are otherwise hard to surface: the stepwise cash-limit reductions (EUR 3,000 to 2,000 to 1,000), the reported persistence of cash preference over cards, and UJP's finding of fiscalisation irregularities at roughly a third of inspected entities.

source_name: Semos DOO Skopje (СЕМОС) - IT integrator serving financial sector
why_relevant: Long-established Skopje IT consulting/integration firm (since 1995) supplying computer equipment and services; a likely channel for bank infrastructure. Registry profile gives financials; its own site would carry customer references.

source_name: World Bank Documents & Reports - North Macedonia policy notes and country economic reports
why_relevant: Policy notes and Western Balkans Regular Economic Reports contain analysis on MK payment-system modernisation, SEPA entry and cross-border payment costs, often with original charts not published locally.

source_name: Комерцијална банка — Општи услови за платежна сметка и платежни услуги (физички лица / нерезиденти)
why_relevant: General terms of business define which fee items exist, value dating, card transaction rules and FX mark-up mechanics — the qualitative layer needed to interpret the numeric tariff.

source_name: Komercijalna Banka AD Skopje investor presentations (vendor-estate proxy)
why_relevant: Listed MK bank publishing periodic presentations with channel/network figures (ATMs, POS, cards). As a named Printec reference customer, its disclosed device counts calibrate vendor installed-base claims and refresh timing.

source_name: IMF — Shadow Economies Around the World (WP/18/17) and Europe's Shadow Economies
why_relevant: Cross-country shadow-economy estimates including North Macedonia (cited at ~37.6% of the economy); provides the comparable regional baseline and the currency-demand methodology that links cash in circulation to informality.

source_name: IMF FAS annual highlights reports and glossary of indicators
why_relevant: Explains definitions and breaks in ATM/POS indicators and gives regional benchmarks against which MK density can be read; essential for avoiding misinterpretation of series changes.

source_name: CEA (Center for Economic Analyses) — Shadow Economy in Macedonia study
why_relevant: Independent think-tank estimate of the shadow economy using national data; the classic non-government benchmark against which official informality figures are compared, and typically discusses cash-demand-based estimation methods.

source_name: Perpetum Mobile Security / Obezbeduvanje (Перпетум Мобиле) - cash transfer services
why_relevant: Major MK private security firm offering 'Трансфер на дневен промет' - collecting retail daily takings, secure transport to its cash centre/vault and depositing into commercial banks. Business-press profiling of its revenue and volumes is an indirect measure of cash intensity and of bank cash-handling outsourcing.

source_name: Faktor.mk — toll tariffs and payment-method explainers
why_relevant: MK business outlet that publishes practical explainers enumerating which payment instruments are accepted at toll plazas (cash, bank cards, contactless smart cards) — useful where the road operator (ЈПДП) publishes sparsely.

source_name: Академски труд: „Провизии при трансакции со платежни картички“ (УГД Штип, Yearbook of Faculty of Law)
why_relevant: Academic decomposition of MK card transaction fee structure (merchant commission, cardholder fees, settlement fees) — gives the conceptual model for parsing acquiring price lists and identifies who bears which cost.

source_name: IT.mk forum — merchant threads on CaSys / e-commerce onboarding
why_relevant: Practitioner forum where MK merchants and developers discuss acquirer onboarding, fees, gateway integration pain and alternatives — an unusually candid, otherwise unpublished view of merchant-side pricing and friction.

source_name: ProCredit Bank MK blog — 'КИБС или МИПС плаќање — која е разликата?'
why_relevant: Bank-published explainer that reveals operational parameters of the two systems as banks actually apply them (thresholds, cut-offs, fee logic, ownership by 15 banks). Bank explainer pages across all MK banks are a cheap, comparable way to reverse-engineer clearing rules and pricing without operator cooperation.

source_name: bne IntelliNews — Nayax and MK cashless acceptance (unattended payments)
why_relevant: Regional business press covering foreign acceptance-technology entrants (Nayax) into MK unattended payments — vending, parking, EV charging — a segment no MK regulator breaks out and a leading indicator of terminal-estate growth.

source_name: EBRD North Macedonia country strategy and results snapshot
why_relevant: Country strategy and diagnostics set out EBRD's read of MK financial-sector gaps (digitalisation, access to finance, capital markets) and the planned pipeline - useful as an independent structural assessment of the market.

source_name: ECB Payments statistics methodological notes (definitions for card/terminal indicators)
why_relevant: Defines 'non-remote card payment', 'terminal', 'card with a payment function' etc. Needed to test whether NBRSM's MK definitions are comparable before any MK-vs-EU benchmark is asserted; prevents false conclusions from definitional mismatch.

source_name: Македонски Телеком — Општи услови за онлајн нарачка и плаќање (PDF)
why_relevant: Terms document for the largest telecom's webshop — typically names the acquiring bank, accepted card schemes, 3DS provider and refund flow; one of the few written disclosures of an enterprise acquiring relationship in MK.

entity_name: Asseco SEE Group annual / management report
source_name: Asseco SEE Group annual / management report (segment disclosures)
why_relevant: Listed-group reporting breaks revenue by segment (Banking Solutions, Payments/Payten) and by country, and describes ATM outsourcing (MoneyGet) and independent EFT-POS (Monri) networks. Gives quantified, auditable vendor-side signals about MK payments infrastructure spend.

source_name: Bertelsmann BTI 2026 — North Macedonia country report
why_relevant: Recurring qualitative assessment that cites the domestic informal-economy range (roughly 21–40%) and frames it as a structural constraint; useful as a dated, citable secondary anchor and a pointer to the underlying local estimates.

source_name: Bruegel — Western Balkans working papers (intra-regional economic integration)
why_relevant: Independent think-tank analysis of intra-Western-Balkans integration provides the analytical framing and comparator datasets used by EU institutions when assessing MK; free full-text PDFs make it a low-friction substitute for paywalled consultancy work.

source_name: Central Bank Payments News — interview with Igor Velickovski, Manager, Payment Systems Department, NBRSM
why_relevant: Named-source interview establishing the responsible NBRSM department and official for payment systems, plus stated intentions on instant payments and PSD2 implementation. Useful for the actor map and for attributing later statements.

source_name: Global Initiative SEE-Obs — North Macedonia illicit financial flows report
why_relevant: Covers illicit financial flows and cash-based value transfer in North Macedonia; a reveals-indirectly source for the part of cash demand that never appears in official informality statistics.

source_name: Karanović & Partners — North Macedonia payment services legislation updates
why_relevant: Regional law firm that publishes timely English-language analyses of MK payments legislation (adoption dates, transitional deadlines, licensing obligations). Faster and clearer than official sources for interpreting what changed and by when.

source_name: MDPI Economies — Rethinking Fiscal Decentralization in Relation to Regional Informality (European transition country)
why_relevant: Peer-reviewed work linking ICT/payment-infrastructure penetration to informality and arguing that promoting electronic transactions and reducing cash reliance raises fiscal revenue — directly on the cash-substitution causal question, with sub-national granularity.

source_name: Netcetera — Halkbank North Macedonia wallet reference case
why_relevant: Vendor reference/case-study pages are one of the few places where MK bank–supplier contracts for wallets, 3DS and contactless are named publicly; supplier reference libraries are a systematic route to the acceptance technology stack.

source_name: Nikob DOOEL Skopje (Никоб) - security and cash-services company
why_relevant: Reported operator of the largest cash-processing centre in the region (Центар за кеш услуги) handling processing, storage and transport of cash for banks and retailers. Cash-in-transit and cash-centre capacity is a direct proxy for cash usage and for banks outsourcing cash handling.

source_name: Skopje Blockchain Summit & Hackathon (Base42 venue ecosystem)
why_relevant: Recurring Skopje hackathon/summit (48h, Base42) drawing regional fintech builders and sponsors. Sponsor lists and challenge briefs occasionally come from banks/PSPs and reveal which institutions are experimenting with open banking, tokenisation or crypto rails.

source_name: Правдико / Nikola Mladenov (LinkedIn) / Pepeljugoski / Nova Konsalting — practitioner commentary on cash rules
why_relevant: Law and accounting practitioners publish the clearest operational reading of the cash rules — the MKD 6,000 per-transaction and MKD 60,000 monthly ceilings for legal entities, the EUR 1,000 general limit from 2025 and the EUR 500 virtual-asset cash limit, plus consumer-side fiscalisation duties. Useful for interpretation, never as the citation of record.

entity_name: Радио МОФ / Слободен печат / Нова Македонија
source_name: Радио МОФ / Слободен печат / Нова Македонија — transit and utility payment-channel reporting
why_relevant: Independent MK outlets that consistently cover launches of new payment channels by municipal utilities and transit operators (virtual bus card, water-bill web payment, parking apps) — a practical event feed for acceptance-side milestones.

entity_name: ЈП Градски паркинг Скопје / Parking.MK app coverage
source_name: ЈП Градски паркинг Скопје / Parking.MK app coverage
why_relevant: Documents the four parking payment channels in Skopje (card-in-app, SMS, QR, scratch cards) and the municipal parking operators (JP Gradski parking, Parkinzi na Opstina Centar / POC) — a clean, measurable micro-payments acceptance segment and a candidate for card-vs-SMS substitution tracking.
